title: Black Box Testing — Live Evaluation Sheet
allocated_time: 2 Hours (3 Evaluators: 2 Technical Advisers + 1 Capstone Adviser)

tracks.focus: Public Access, Shared Portal, Student, Employee & Clinic Operations
Team Workspace, Interdepartmental Referrals & Guidance Operations
Facilities (BMG), Reports, Audit Trail, Platform Admin & Optional Grants

cases.scenario: Verify a visitor can read the Data Privacy Policy without signing in
steps: Open a browser without signing in.
Navigate to the Data Privacy Policy page (/privacy-policy).
Scroll through the sections and check the Back to Sign In link.
cases.expected: The full Foundation University Data Privacy Policy opens cleanly with a working Back to Sign In button.

cases.scenario: Verify the Data Privacy Policy modal opens from the Sign-In screen
steps: Open any SYNAPSE login screen.
Click the Data Privacy Policy link on the login card.
Read the notice inside the popup modal and close it.
cases.expected: The Data Privacy Policy modal opens cleanly and lets the user return to the login form.

cases.scenario: Verify sign-in with an invalid password or repeated wrong attempts
steps: Open the login page.
Enter an invalid username or wrong password and click Sign In.
Repeat wrong sign-in attempts several times.
cases.expected: System displays an error message without logging in and temporarily slows down repeated failed attempts.

cases.scenario: Verify a user can sign in with valid credentials on the matching portal
steps: Open the portal or workstation login page.
Enter valid university credentials.
Click Sign In.
cases.expected: The user is authenticated and redirected to their Home Dashboard.

cases.scenario: Verify anyone can check the authenticity of a printed Guidance document
steps: Open the public document verification page.
Enter a valid document code and security code (or scan its QR link).
Click Verify.
cases.expected: System confirms whether the document is authentic and displays only basic document status without exposing personal details.

cases.scenario: Verify logout ends the session and browser Back button cannot reopen pages
steps: Sign in with a valid account.
Click Sign Out and confirm.
Press the browser Back button.
cases.expected: The session ends and the user stays on the login screen instead of returning to private pages.

cases.scenario: Verify a user cannot enter a department workstation without matching role rights
steps: Sign in as a Student on the personal portal.
Open a staff workstation URL (for example, Clinic or Admin) in the address bar.
Observe the system response.
cases.expected: Access is denied cleanly and no department patient, counselling, or admin data is shown.

cases.scenario: Verify user can update contact details while official university fields stay locked
steps: Open My Profile in the portal.
Edit the phone number or current residence address and click Save.
Check university ID and enrollment fields.
cases.expected: Contact details save successfully while official university identity fields remain read-only.

cases.scenario: Verify user can upload a profile photo and update emergency contact details
steps: Open My Profile and go to Profile Photo and Emergency Contact.
Upload a valid image file and enter an emergency contact person and number.
Click Save.
cases.expected: The new profile photo and emergency contact details appear on the profile.

cases.scenario: Verify user can open personal notifications, mark them read, and collapse the sidebar
steps: Click the bell icon to open the notification inbox.
Mark one notification (or Mark All) as read.
Resize or toggle the navigation drawer on desktop/mobile view.
cases.expected: Unread count drops after marking read and the responsive menu drawer opens and closes smoothly.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can submit an appointment request to Clinic or Guidance
steps: Sign in as a Student and open Appointments.
Choose department, preferred schedule/reason, and submit the request.
View the My Appointments list.
cases.expected: The new appointment request appears in the student's list with Pending/Requested status.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can cancel an eligible pending appointment
steps: Open My Appointments as a Student.
Click Cancel on an upcoming pending appointment.
Enter a short cancellation reason and confirm.
cases.expected: The appointment status changes to Cancelled immediately.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can view live queue position and personal visit history
steps: Sign in as a Student with a queue ticket and past visits.
Check the Live Queue card on the Home Dashboard.
Open the Visit History page.
cases.expected: Current queue number/status and nonclinical past visit dates appear cleanly without clinical notes.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can read Clinic or Guidance announcements
steps: Open Announcements in the Student portal.
Click on an active published announcement.
Return to the announcements list.
cases.expected: The announcement text opens and is marked as read for that student's account.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can answer and submit a published Guidance survey
steps: Open Surveys in the Student portal.
Open an active survey, answer the rating scale and choice questions.
Click Submit.
cases.expected: System records the submission and shows the survey as Completed so it cannot be submitted twice.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can acknowledge a received Guidance call slip
steps: Open Call Slips in the Student portal.
Click an unacknowledged call slip issued by a counsellor.
Click Acknowledge.
cases.expected: The call slip updates to Acknowledged with a confirmation timestamp.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can complete an assigned Multiple Intelligences test and download PDF
steps: Open an assigned MI assessment as a Student.
Answer the items, review, and click Finalize Submission.
View the eight-domain profile and click Download PDF.
cases.expected: All eight intelligence domain scores appear clearly and the MI result PDF downloads cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can redeem an evaluation code and submit anonymous feedback
steps: Open Service Evaluation and enter a valid one-time evaluation token (PEF-008 or CEF-009).
Fill in the ratings and optional comment.
Click Submit.
cases.expected: Feedback is accepted once, and trying the same evaluation code a second time is rejected.

cases.scenario: Verify a student can sign in on the mobile personal app and view portal status
steps: Open the SYNAPSE Mobile app.
Select the university server and sign in as a Student.
Check Home dashboard, Appointments, and Notifications tabs.
cases.expected: The mobile dashboard loads the student's active queue, appointments, and notifications smoothly.

cases.scenario: Verify an employee can refer students to Guidance using form GGR-005
steps: Sign in as an Employee (Faculty/Staff).
Open Guidance Referral (GGR-005), select one or more students, enter observed behavior and reason.
Click Submit Referral.
cases.expected: The referral is created and listed under the employee's submitted referrals.

cases.scenario: Verify an employee can withdraw a pending referral before Guidance accepts it
steps: Open Submitted Referrals as the Employee.
Locate a pending referral that has not yet been accepted.
Click Withdraw Referral and confirm.
cases.expected: The referral status changes to Withdrawn immediately.

cases.scenario: Verify a Clinic Intern can browse patient records, isolation list, and clearances
steps: Sign in as a Clinic Intern with an active shift.
Open Patient Records and search for a student.
Check Isolation Tracker and Clearances tabs.
cases.expected: Clinical summaries and records are visible in read-only mode.

cases.scenario: Verify a Clinic Intern can check in an arriving patient and call the next ticket
steps: Open the Clinic Queue screen as Clinic Intern.
Check in a scheduled or walk-in patient.
Click Call Next on the waiting queue item.
cases.expected: The ticket moves to In Service and the queue updates.

cases.scenario: Verify a Clinic Intern can open an encounter and save draft vitals and notes
steps: Open an active Clinic encounter as Clinic Intern.
Enter vital signs (temperature, blood pressure) and initial complaints.
Click Save Draft.
cases.expected: The draft vitals and notes are saved cleanly to the open encounter.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Intern sees inventory read-only and cannot seal encounters or dispense medicine
steps: Open Medicine Inventory as Clinic Intern and verify stock levels are visible.
Look for stock adjustment, medicine dispensing, and Seal Encounter buttons.
Confirm those final action controls are disabled or blocked.
cases.expected: Clinic Intern can view inventory read-only and is blocked from adjusting stock, dispensing medicine, or sealing encounters.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can update a patient's health profile and record lab results
steps: Sign in as Clinic Staff and open a patient's profile.
Update allergies/medical history and save.
Attach or record a delayed laboratory test result.
cases.expected: Health profile changes and laboratory results appear in the patient's record.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can dispense medicine from a batch and seal the encounter
steps: Open an active clinical encounter as Clinic Staff.
Select a medicine batch, enter dispensed quantity, and save.
Click Seal Encounter and confirm.
cases.expected: Stock batch quantity deducts automatically and the encounter becomes sealed and locked from direct edits.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can append a signed addendum to an already sealed encounter
steps: Open a previously sealed clinical encounter.
Click Add Addendum, enter follow-up notes, and submit.
View the encounter timeline.
cases.expected: The original sealed record stays unchanged while the timestamped addendum is appended below it.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can confirm, reschedule, and check in student appointments (while availability templates stay admin-only)
steps: Open Clinic Appointments as Clinic Staff.
Confirm or reschedule a pending student appointment and verify same-day queue check-in.
Confirm provider availability setup remains restricted to Clinic Administrator.
cases.expected: Student appointments confirm and check in cleanly, while /clinic/appointments/availability stays blocked (403) for non-admin Clinic Staff.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can receive medicine batches, quarantine stock, and reverse mistakes
steps: Open Medicine Inventory as Clinic Staff.
Receive a new batch with lot number and expiry date.
Test quarantine/adjustment and reverse an incorrect stock log entry.
cases.expected: Batch balances update accurately and the ledger records every stock movement and reversal.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can record a communicable isolation case and later mark it cleared
steps: Open Isolation Tracker and log a new student isolation case.
Save the case and verify it shows as Active.
Open the case and record Medical Clearance.
cases.expected: The case starts as Active and moves to Cleared with a clearance date.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can issue an enrollment or medical health clearance
steps: Open Clearances and Certificates in Clinic.
Select a student, enter clearance purpose/remarks, and click Issue Clearance.
Preview or print the issued clearance.
cases.expected: The health clearance is issued, recorded on the student's profile, and ready for printing.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can view monthly Clinic summary reports and download PDF
steps: Open Clinic Reports.
Choose a date range and view consultation and medicine totals.
Click Export PDF.
cases.expected: On-screen totals match the period and a cleanly formatted Clinic PDF report downloads.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Staff can create and send an interdepartmental referral to Guidance
steps: Open Referrals in Clinic and click New Referral.
Select a student, set Guidance as target department, enter non-sensitive referral summary, and submit.
Check Outgoing Referrals list.
cases.expected: The referral is created with Pending status and appears for the Guidance team.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Physician can examine an open encounter, prescribe/dispense, and seal it
steps: Sign in as Clinic Physician.
Open a triaged encounter, review vitals, add diagnosis/plan, and dispense medicine if needed.
Click Seal Encounter.
cases.expected: Clinic Physician seals the encounter successfully with physician signature attribution.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Administrator can publish Clinic announcements and manage provider availability
steps: Sign in as Clinic Administrator and open Clinic Announcements.
Click New Announcement, enter title/body, set status to Published, and save.
Open Clinic Provider Availability and confirm schedule templates save cleanly.
cases.expected: The published Clinic announcement appears in the portal and Clinic provider availability templates save without error.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Administrator can archive a Clinic/Team record and restore it cleanly
steps: Open an inactive Clinic Team item or eligible Clinic record as Clinic Administrator.
Click Archive and enter a reason.
Open the Archive Center, locate the item, and click Restore.
cases.expected: The archived item moves to the Archive Center and returns to active view when restored.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Administrator can assign a Clinic Intern placement and control active shifts
steps: Open Student Intern Governance in Clinic Admin.
Assign an enrolled student intern with supervisor and shift schedule.
Test revoking or updating the placement.
cases.expected: The student intern gets Clinic Intern access only while their shift placement is active.

cases.scenario: Verify Clinic Administrator can grant Clinic employee access and sync department directory
steps: Open Employee Access Management in Clinic.
Assign or revoke Clinic workstation access for a staff account.
Trigger Scoped MIS Directory Sync.
cases.expected: Staff access updates immediately and the directory sync completes without affecting other departments.

cases.scenario: Verify a department member can create, update, and complete a Team task
steps: Open Team Workspace -> Tasks in a department workstation.
Create a new task with assignee, due date, and checklist item.
Tick the checklist item and mark the task Complete.
cases.expected: The task appears on the board, updates progress, and moves cleanly to Completed.

cases.scenario: Verify a department member can add and cancel a Team Calendar event
steps: Open Team Calendar and click Add Event.
Enter event title, time, and save.
Open the created event and click Cancel Event.
cases.expected: The calendar displays the scheduled event and removes/marks it cancelled cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify members can chat with @mentions and load older messages by scrolling
steps: Open Team Chat and send a message using @ to mention a teammate.
Scroll up to load earlier chat history.
Click the scroll-to-latest button to jump back down.
cases.expected: The @mentioned teammate gets a generic notification, older messages load smoothly, and jump-to-latest works.

cases.scenario: Verify the receiving department can acknowledge and review an incoming referral
steps: Open Incoming Referrals in the receiving workstation.
Click a pending referral from the other department.
Click Acknowledge / Mark Under Review.
cases.expected: The referral updates to Acknowledged / Under Review for both departments.

cases.scenario: Verify a reviewed referral can be converted into a Clinic encounter or Guidance intake/case
steps: Open an acknowledged referral in the receiving department.
Click Convert to Encounter (Clinic) or Open Intake/Case (Guidance).
Confirm creation.
cases.expected: A linked encounter or Guidance case/intake opens with prefilled student referral info.

cases.scenario: Verify an acted-upon interdepartmental referral can be closed into history
steps: Open a handed-off referral.
Click Close Referral and enter brief outcome remarks.
Confirm closure.
cases.expected: The referral moves to Closed History without exposing confidential clinical notes to the sender.

cases.scenario: Verify a Guidance Intern can operate the daily Guidance queue and view schedules
steps: Sign in as Guidance Intern during an active shift.
Open the Guidance Queue and check in/call the next waiting student.
Check the department schedule overview.
cases.expected: The queue advances cleanly and scheduled appointments display properly.

cases.scenario: Verify a Guidance Intern can log an intake request and run initial safety triage
steps: Open Guidance Intakes as Guidance Intern.
Complete a walk-in or referred intake form and mark safety screening flags.
Submit the intake for counselling.
cases.expected: The intake is saved and urgent safety flags are highlighted prominently for review.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Intern can search Clients Directory and open assigned cases only
steps: Open Clients Directory and search for an assigned student.
Open the student's assigned case.
Confirm unassigned private cases remain inaccessible.
cases.expected: Directory search works cleanly and the intern sees only their assigned cases.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Intern form drafts require Supervisor co-sign before finalizing
steps: Open an assigned case as Guidance Intern and draft a clinical/consultation form (CCF-009).
Click Save / Submit for Co-Sign.
Verify the intern cannot self-finalize without supervisor co-signature.
cases.expected: The form saves in Pending Co-Sign status awaiting a Guidance Supervisor.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can open a case, record confidential session notes, and schedule follow-up
steps: Sign in as Counsellor and open an assigned case (or create one from intake).
Add a new Counseling Session note and set a follow-up date.
Click Save Session.
cases.expected: The session note and follow-up reminder appear in the case timeline.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can manage care episodes and request a case transfer
steps: Open a client folder and create or update a Care Episode.
Record consultation notes and initiate a Transfer to another counsellor.
Confirm the transfer status.
cases.expected: The care episode tracks progress and the transfer updates case ownership properly.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can fill out and finalize official OGC forms (PIF-008, PCF-008, CCF-009)
steps: Open Controlled Forms inside a student case.
Fill in required fields for PIF-008, PCF-008, or CCF-009.
Click Finalize Form.
cases.expected: The form validates required OGC fields, saves, and locks with a unique document code.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can generate and print an official OGC form PDF
steps: Open a finalized OGC form in the case.
Click Print / Download Official PDF.
Inspect the generated PDF header and contents.
cases.expected: The formatted Foundation University OGC PDF opens with institutional header and verification code.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can issue a controlled Call Slip (CSP-007) and GAP-006 form
steps: Open a student case and click Issue Call Slip (CSP-007).
Enter date, time, venue, and reason, then click Send.
Check the student's portal or GAP-006 record.
cases.expected: The call slip is issued with an official number and notifies the student immediately.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can assign an MI assessment and interpret completed results
steps: Open Assessments in Guidance and assign an MI test to a student.
Open a completed student MI submission.
Review all eight domain scores and export PDF.
cases.expected: The MI assignment is created and completed scores display clearly for counselling review.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can issue an evaluation code and see anonymous aggregate scores
steps: Open a completed counselling encounter and click Issue Evaluation Code.
Open Own Evaluation Summary.
Check displayed average ratings.
cases.expected: A one-time token is generated and aggregate ratings show only after enough anonymous responses exist.

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor can confirm, book, and manage student appointments (while availability templates stay supervisor/admin-only)
steps: Open Guidance Appointments as Counsellor.
Book, confirm, or check in a student appointment on an open slot.
Confirm counsellor availability setup remains restricted to Guidance Supervisor / Admin.
cases.expected: The student appointment appears on both Counsellor and Student schedules, while /guidance/appointments/availability stays blocked (403).

cases.scenario: Verify a Counsellor cannot open another counsellor's confidential case
steps: Sign in as Counsellor A.
Search or try opening a case assigned exclusively to Counsellor B.
Observe access response.
cases.expected: Access is denied so confidential counselling notes remain strictly private.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Supervisor can oversee all Guidance cases and reassign caseloads
steps: Sign in as Guidance Supervisor and browse all unit cases.
Open a case assigned to a counsellor.
Use Reassign Case to transfer it to another counsellor.
cases.expected: Supervisor can review every case and reassignment transfers caseload ownership immediately.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Supervisor can review and co-sign pending clinical forms
steps: Open the Pending Co-Sign queue as Guidance Supervisor.
Review a draft form submitted by a Guidance Intern.
Click Co-Sign & Finalize.
cases.expected: The form becomes finalized with both the drafter's and supervisor's names recorded.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Supervisor can publish announcements and build a new student survey
steps: Publish a Guidance announcement.
Open Question Bank / Surveys and add rating scale or multiple-choice items.
Publish the survey.
cases.expected: The announcement and new survey become visible for students in their portal.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Supervisor can inspect survey totals and moderate evaluation comments
steps: Open Survey Responses and review summary charts/counts.
Open Evaluation Comment Moderation.
Approve or hide a submitted student comment.
cases.expected: Survey results display cleanly and only approved comments appear in reports.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Supervisor can manage controlled forms, practitioner profiles, rollout gates, and counsellor availability
steps: Open Form Governance and Activation Gates settings in Guidance.
Inspect OGC form definitions and Practitioner Profiles.
Open Guidance Provider Availability and confirm counsellor schedules load for management.
cases.expected: Supervisor views and updates form governance, practitioner activation gates, and counsellor availability cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Administrator can place and lift a Legal Hold on an archived record
steps: Sign in as Guidance Administrator and open an archived Guidance record.
Click Place Legal Hold with a reason and confirm.
Test lifting the legal hold afterward.
cases.expected: While held, the record cannot be purged; lifting the hold restores normal retention rules.

cases.scenario: Verify Guidance Administrator can manage Guidance Intern placements and staff access
steps: Open Guidance Intern Governance and assign a Guidance Intern shift.
Open Guidance Employee Access and check workstation grants.
Confirm changes save properly.
cases.expected: Guidance intern placements and staff access settings update cleanly for Guidance only.

cases.scenario: Verify a BMG Intern can view composting drums, active batches, and metrics
steps: Sign in as BMG Intern with an active shift.
Open the BMG Facilities dashboard.
Inspect drum status, temperature/moisture readings, and batch logs.
cases.expected: Composting unit statuses, batches, and recorded readings display cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify a BMG Intern cannot add, edit, or archive composting drum units
steps: Sign in as BMG Intern.
Open a composting drum detail view.
Check that Register Unit, Archive Unit, and hardware setup controls are unavailable.
cases.expected: BMG Intern is prevented from modifying or archiving composting infrastructure.

cases.scenario: Verify a Facilities Operator can start a composting batch on an available drum
steps: Sign in as Facilities Operator and choose an idle drum unit.
Click Start Batch, enter waste weight and notes.
Click Save.
cases.expected: The batch becomes Active and the drum shows an active batch in progress.

cases.scenario: Verify a Facilities Operator can finish/release or cancel an active composting batch
steps: Open an active composting batch as Facilities Operator.
Record final output weight and click Release Batch (or test Cancel on a test batch).
Check the drum status.
cases.expected: The batch closes cleanly in history and the drum returns to ready/idle state.

cases.scenario: Verify BMG Administrator can register, edit, and archive composting drum units
steps: Sign in as BMG Administrator and open Composting Units.
Add or edit a drum unit and toggle Maintenance mode.
Archive a retired test unit.
cases.expected: Composting unit details update cleanly and archived units leave the active list.

cases.scenario: Verify BMG Administrator can configure and trigger drum rotation schedules
steps: Open a composting unit's Rotation Schedule settings.
Set rotation interval and duration, then click Save Schedule.
Click Run / Trigger Rotation Test if enabled.
cases.expected: The rotation schedule saves cleanly and displays next scheduled rotation time.

cases.scenario: Verify BMG Administrator can restore an archived BMG item and assign a BMG Intern
steps: Open the Archive Center in BMG and restore an archived BMG/Team record.
Open BMG Intern Governance and view/assign a BMG Intern placement.
Save changes.
cases.expected: The archived record restores properly and BMG Intern scheduling updates cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify a Report Viewer can view aggregate operational dashboards across modules
steps: Sign in as Report Viewer.
Open the Reports dashboard and apply a date filter.
Check Clinic, Guidance, and BMG aggregate counts.
cases.expected: Summary charts and numeric totals display accurately without private individual notes.

cases.scenario: Verify Report Viewer can export CSV/PDF reports and cannot open Admin or Audit pages
steps: Click Export CSV and Export PDF on a filtered report.
Try opening the Audit Explorer or Platform Admin URLs.
Observe access response.
cases.expected: CSV and PDF reports download cleanly while Audit Explorer and Admin routes remain blocked.

cases.scenario: Verify Audit Reader can search system audit logs and verify tamper-evident chain integrity
steps: Sign in as Audit Reader and open Audit Explorer.
Filter audit entries by actor, action, or date range.
Click Verify Hash Chain.
cases.expected: Matching audit events display cleanly and chain verification confirms no tampering.

cases.scenario: Verify Audit Reader can inspect archived items, retention rules, and holds read-only
steps: Open the Archive Center as Audit Reader.
Browse archived records, Legal Holds, and Retention Policies.
Confirm edit/restore/purge buttons are not permitted.
cases.expected: Archive Center records and policies are visible in read-only mode with no write actions allowed.

cases.scenario: Verify Platform Owner can sign in on the Admin workstation using break-glass login
steps: Open the Admin workstation login page.
Enter the configured local operator/superadmin credentials.
Click Sign In.
cases.expected: Superadmin signs in directly and opens the Platform Administration dashboard.

cases.scenario: Verify Superadmin can manage RBAC role assignments, MIS sync, and sign-in carousel banners
steps: Open User & Role Management and inspect or update a user's department role.
Open Sign-In Carousel settings and preview/toggle a login banner.
Open MIS Sync panel and check sync status.
cases.expected: Role permissions, carousel slides, and platform operations update cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify Superadmin can configure archive retention rules while immutable logs stay protected
steps: Open Archive Center -> Retention Policies as Superadmin.
Adjust retention days for an eligible category and save.
Verify audit/security ledgers cannot be permanently deleted.
cases.expected: Retention policies save properly and immutable ledgers remain protected from purge.

cases.scenario: Verify Superadmin can configure AI provider settings and grant AI access to staff
steps: Open Platform AI Configuration as Superadmin.
Verify provider model settings and test connection status.
Assign or revoke an explicit AI grant for a department staff member.
cases.expected: AI provider settings and department staff AI grants save cleanly.

cases.scenario: Verify an authorized Hardware Operator can commission a controller and send device commands
steps: Sign in with a facilities.hardware.manage grant.
Open Hardware Devices and check online/commissioned controller status.
Issue a test motor/aeration command.
cases.expected: The device acknowledges the command cleanly and logs the telemetry/action.

cases.scenario: Verify an authorized Hardware Operator can generate USB firmware provisioning
steps: Open USB Firmware Provisioning under BMG Hardware.
Select target controller profile and generate provisioning package.
Verify authorization challenge completes.
cases.expected: The provisioning package builds cleanly with device credentials ready to flash.

cases.scenario: Verify AI-granted staff can generate an aggregate AI insight summary for their unit
steps: Sign in as staff granted ai.insights access.
Open AI Insights, select a department date range, and preview the anonymized summary input.
Click Generate AI Insight.
cases.expected: System generates a readable aggregate trend report in Draft/Pending Review state without personal names.

cases.scenario: Verify an authorized reviewer can approve a generated AI insight for viewing
steps: Open a newly generated AI Insight draft.
Review the recommendations and click Approve Insight.
Open the Approved Insights tab.
cases.expected: The insight moves to Approved status and becomes visible to authorized readers.
